sections.heading: Intro
sections.content_markdown:
Layer 5 is the matching engine's rulebook. It translates **Layer 4 goal direction × user state (available days, equipment, phase, history) × current macrocycle position** into a concrete weekly schedule built from Layer 1 templates filled with Layer 8 entries. Layer 5 does NOT contain new training doctrine — it operationalizes what Layers 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, and 8 already define.
**Read order**: Foundation (this section, conventions and shared rules) → per-goal coupling entry → Special weeks (overrides applied last).

entries.heading: Canonical deload
entries.content_markdown:
**Definition**: -40% volume, -10% load, hold technique. Same exercises as the prior week; sets dropped by ~40%; loads scaled back ~10%. Same template selection, same slot rules. Conditioning intensity reduced (Zone 2 only; no tempo/intervals).
**Default trigger**: Every 4th week of a mesocycle (3 weeks load progression → 1 week deload). Templates with their own deload signals (RPE >8 on Superset A for 3 sessions, etc.) trigger deload earlier and reset the mesocycle counter.
**Template-specific overrides**: If a Layer 1 template's Decision rules name a different deload behavior, that template's rule wins for that template's sessions. The canonical applies to the rest of the user's week.

entries.heading: Macrocycle structure (MEV → MAV → MRV)
entries.content_markdown:
**Standard 12-week macrocycle**: 3 mesocycles of 4 weeks each. Each mesocycle: wk1 MEV (minimum effective volume entry) → wk2 MAV (maximum adaptive volume mid) → wk3 MRV (maximum recoverable volume peak) → wk4 deload (canonical). Goal-specific macrocycle structures override (e.g., C-cluster race blocks follow event-week-counting periodization; F-cluster pregnancy phases follow gestational milestones; E-cluster rehab phases follow symptom-graduation criteria).
**Volume progression within mesocycle**: Sets scale wk1→wk3 per Layer 2 doctrine (MEV→MAV→MRV). Loads scale modestly (+5% per week if RPE held at target). Decision rules in Layer 1 templates intercept before MRV is reached if recovery markers deteriorate.
**Mesocycle entry rule**: A new mesocycle starts from the wk1 MEV baseline regardless of where the prior mesocycle ended. If the prior mesocycle's wk4 was a forced deload (decision-rule-triggered, not scheduled), the new mesocycle's wk1 may start at a reduced baseline (~85% of prior MEV) — Program Designer's call based on recovery markers.

entries.heading: Frequency coupling defaults
entries.content_markdown:
**2 days/week**: Reactivator Phase 1 entry, F1 Pregnancy T1, F3 Pregnancy late T3, F6 Senior fitness entry, maintenance phases of A4/D1. Default templates: Full Body OR Reactivator Phase 1 (2-day).
**3 days/week**: Most goal entry points outside specialist tracks. Default split: hinge-emphasis / squat-emphasis / upper-emphasis (or Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A as named templates).
**4 days/week**: Hypertrophy emphasis, strength-focused intermediate, hybrid Phase 2+. Default: Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A / Upper + Core (4-day split).
**5+ days/week**: Performance-mode (Hyrox prep peak, race prep peak, B2 strength peak block). Splits depend on goal; conditioning sessions count toward the total.

entries.heading: Conditioning subtype scheduling (canonical patterns)
entries.content_markdown:
Three reference patterns, drawn from established periodization literature already cited in Layer 4 Sources (Seiler 2010 polarized; Joyner & Coyle 2008 endurance physiology; Magness 2014 running periodization; Mangine 2020 HIIT/strength integration):
**Polarized base (Seiler)**: ~80% Zone 2, ~20% threshold/VO2max. Default for off-season and base phases (C1/C2/C3/D2).
**Pyramidal (event-prep)**: ~70% Zone 2, ~20% tempo, ~10% intervals. Default for 8-12 weeks pre-event (C1, C2, C3, C5).
**Hyrox-specific (Mangine)**: 2-3 strength sessions/week + 2-3 conditioning sessions/week + 1 simulation/week in peak phase. Default for C4.
Layer 5 references these patterns; it does not redefine them. If new conditioning research is needed for a goal, flag to KB Editor in the next cycle — do not invent in Layer 5.

entries.heading: Combo session triggering
entries.content_markdown: Combo session = single-pair strength compound (Superset A only) → ~20 min Zone 2 transition → strength finisher (Superset C only). ~60 min total. **Available templates**: Hybrid-in-comeback Phase 2 Loaded (1×/week). **Eligible goals**: A5 Hybrid-in-comeback Phase 2, C4 Hybrid athlete Phase 2 reentry, B3 Strength endurance with hybrid context. **Not eligible**: trained-user goals without hybrid context, any rehab phase, any pregnancy phase.

entries.heading: Special weeks (overrides)
entries.content_markdown:
**Race week / event week**: Maintenance only. No new stimulus. Mobility priority. Last hard session ≥4 days pre-event. Eligible: any C-cluster goal in peak/event-week. Eligible: G5 Stage prep — show week.
**Deload week**: Canonical (-40% volume, -10% load) unless template specifies otherwise. Applied wk4 of standard macrocycle OR decision-rule-triggered.
**Recovery week (post-illness, life-event, travel disruption)**: MEV-only, mobility daily, no conditioning above Zone 2. Restart cycle wk1 MEV after recovery week.
**Symptom-flare week (E-cluster rehab phases)**: Drop to the prior phase's template for that week. Re-graduate via the phase's transition criterion before progressing again.

entries.heading: Conventions
entries.content_markdown:
**Coupling entries reference Layer 4 goal codes (A1, B2, etc.) and Layer 1 template names exactly.** Phase notation matches Layer 4 Achievement markers' phase taxonomy where it exists; otherwise the entry is single-block.
**"Eligible templates" lists templates that the matching engine may select.** Multiple eligible templates per goal-phase is normal (e.g., for A1 Reactivator Phase 1 the engine picks between specific phase templates based on user time-availability and equipment).
**Decision rules in Layer 1 templates remain authoritative for within-template behavior.** Layer 5 governs which template is selected and how the week is shaped; the template governs how that session executes.
**Phase transitions reference Layer 4 Achievement markers.** Layer 5 does not duplicate phase-transition criteria; it points to them.
---

entries.heading: A1 · Get lean
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (comeback persona phasing — see Comeback Templates in Layer 1)
*Phase 1 Foundation*: Reactivator Phase 1 Foundation (2-day). For non-comeback A1 users (no extended pause history): Full Body 2-day OR 3-day.
*Phase 2 Loaded*: Reactivator Phase 2 Loaded (3-day) OR Lower P / Upper PP / Full Body 3-day mix.
*Phase 3 Capacity*: Reactivator Phase 3 Capacity (3-day or 4-day variant) OR full Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A / Upper + Core 4-day split.
**Frequency coupling**: Phase 1 = 2 days/week strict. Phase 2 = 3 days/week. Phase 3 = 3-4 days/week (user choice + recovery capacity).
**Conditioning subtypes**: Phase 1 = none. Phase 2 = optional Zone 2 walk (recovery-tier, HR <125). Phase 3 = optional Zone 2 sessions 30-40 min, 1-2×/week, polarized base pattern.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 A1 Achievement markers (Signal/Window/Next step). Phase 1→2 = 4 consecutive clean sessions. Phase 2→3 = compound lifts at user-defined baseline OR 4 weeks RPE 7 without back-off. Phase 3 = goal target reached (body composition signal).
**Special weeks**: Standard deload at mesocycle wk4. Recovery week if life-event disrupts pattern for >1 week.

entries.heading: A2 · Build muscle / lean bulk
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (comeback persona phasing where applicable — Returning Athlete persona, OR Reactivator A2 secondary)
*Returning Athlete Phase 1 Re-entry*: Returning Athlete Phase 1 Re-entry (3-day).
*Returning Athlete Phase 2-3*: Returning Athlete Phase 2 Loaded (4-day) OR Phase 3 Capacity (4-day).
*Non-comeback A2 (trained user)*: Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A / Upper + Core 4-day split. Full Body 2-day or 3-day for time-constrained users.
**Frequency coupling**: 3-4 days/week standard. 2-day Full Body acceptable for time-constrained users (lower expected progression rate).
**Conditioning subtypes**: None mandatory. Optional Zone 2 1-2×/week if user wishes to maintain aerobic base; do not exceed Zone 2 during hypertrophy block.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 A2 Achievement markers. Rate of gain check at wk4 and wk8. Block end at 10-16 weeks.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload at mesocycle wk4. Mini-cut transition if body fat trends high (route to A1 or A3).

entries.heading: A3 · Body recomposition
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (single-block goal, no phase taxonomy in Layer 4)
Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A / Upper + Core 4-day split (primary). Full Body 3-day (time-constrained). Returning Athlete Phase 2-3 (comeback-history user).
**Frequency coupling**: 3-4 days/week. Recomp benefits from higher session frequency for muscle stimulus while in slight deficit; do not drop below 3 days.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Optional Zone 2 1-2×/week. Avoid tempo/intervals during recomp (interference with hypertrophy in deficit).
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 A3 Achievement markers. Rolling 4-week measurement check; 12-24 week typical block duration.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. If stalling for 6+ weeks, route to dedicated cut (A1/A4) or bulk (A2) per A3 Achievement markers' Next step.

entries.heading: A4 · Sustainable fat loss
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A 3-day split (primary). Full Body 3-day (time-constrained). Reactivator Phase 2-3 (comeback-history user).
**Frequency coupling**: 3 days/week standard. 4 days/week if user has capacity AND deficit is moderate. Higher frequency NOT recommended on aggressive deficits.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Zone 2 2-3×/week, 30-45 min. Adds calorie expenditure without compromising recovery in deficit. Polarized base pattern (Seiler).
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 A4 Achievement markers. Sustainability check at wk12, wk24, and at goal-reached.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Extended maintenance phase (≥12 weeks) mandatory before any further fat-loss block.

entries.heading: A5 · Major weight loss
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (comeback persona phasing — Hybrid-in-comeback for users with cross-modal history; Reactivator otherwise)
*Phase 1 Foundation*: Hybrid-in-comeback Phase 1 Foundation (3-day strength + 2-day Z2) OR Reactivator Phase 1 Foundation (2-day) for users without cross-modal history.
*Phase 2 Loaded*: Hybrid-in-comeback Phase 2 Loaded (4-day mixed, includes combo session) OR Reactivator Phase 2 Loaded (3-day).
*Phase 3 Capacity*: Hybrid-in-comeback Phase 3 Capacity (4-day balanced) OR Reactivator Phase 3 Capacity (3-4 day).
**Frequency coupling**: Phase 1 = 2-3 days strength + 2 days conditioning. Phase 2 = 4 mixed days/week. Phase 3 = 4 days/week balanced.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Phase 1 = Zone 2 walk/bike/easy row only, 30-40 min. Phase 2 = Zone 2 default + 1× tempo per week. Phase 3 = full conditioning subtype range per user goal.
**Combo session**: Available in Phase 2 (1×/week per Hybrid-in-comeback Phase 2 template).
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 A5 Achievement markers. Milestone-based (typically -20 kg or -15% body weight). 6-18 month total typical.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Long-term maintenance phase post-goal mandatory (extended, ≥12 weeks).
---

entries.heading: B1 · General strength
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (single-block goal; trained-user track)
Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A / Upper + Core 4-day split (primary). Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A 3-day. Full Body 3-day for time-constrained. Reactivator/Returning Athlete Phase 3 for comeback-history users transitioning out of comeback.
**Frequency coupling**: 3-4 days/week. 3-day for general fitness emphasis; 4-day for accelerated progress.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Optional Zone 2 1-2×/week to maintain aerobic base. No tempo/intervals during strength block (interference).
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 B1 Achievement markers (key lift targets: e.g., bodyweight bench, 1.5× BW squat, 2× BW deadlift, scaled per user). Single-test confirmation across 2-week window.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Mesocycle progression: MEV → MAV → MRV → deload.

entries.heading: B2 · Strength peak
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (single-block goal; peak-cycle programming)
Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A / Upper + Core 4-day split with peak-week tapering. Full Body 3-day for very experienced peakers (rare).
**Frequency coupling**: 4 days/week peak block standard. Peak week reduces to 3 days max with single top-set per primary lift.
**Conditioning subtypes**: None during peak block. Optional Zone 2 1×/week ONLY for maintenance.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 B2 Achievement markers. Single-test on planned peak day. Counts only with planned peak structure (taper preceded, RPE progression respected).
**Special weeks**: Mandatory peak-week taper (Race week pattern adapted: -50% volume, hold load, single top-set scheduled for peak day). Mandatory deload (1-2 weeks) post-peak before any further block.

entries.heading: B3 · Strength endurance
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (single-block goal; can include hybrid elements)
Full Body 2-3 day OR Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A 3-day with higher rep ranges per template adjustments. Hybrid-in-comeback Phase 2 Loaded for users entering B3 from a comeback context (includes combo session for capacity-building).
**Frequency coupling**: 3 days/week standard. 4 days/week with combo session if hybrid context.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Optional Zone 2 1-2×/week. Tempo work allowed (B3 is endurance-oriented, less interference risk).
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 B3 Achievement markers (target rep capacity or functional task at duration).
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Test week scheduled at end of block (test-day = single-test or 2-week confirmation per the marker).
---

entries.heading: C1 · Race prep — short distance (5K–10K)
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (single-block goal with macrocycle phasing operationalized below)
Run template (Zone 2 / tempo / intervals / long run subtypes selected per macrocycle phase). Strength: Lower P / Full Body 1-2× per week for maintenance.
**Frequency coupling**: 4-5 sessions/week typical. 3-4 run sessions + 1-2 strength sessions.
**Conditioning subtypes**:
*Base phase (wk -12 to -8)*: Polarized base (Seiler) — Z2 80%, tempo 20%. Long run 1×/week.
*Build phase (wk -8 to -3)*: Pyramidal — Z2 70%, tempo 20%, intervals 10%. Long run 1×/week, distance progressive.
*Peak phase (wk -3 to -1)*: Volume drops, intensity holds. Tune-up session at wk -2 (per Achievement markers).
*Race week*: Special week pattern (Race week override).
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 C1 Achievement markers. Race day = single-test. Tune-up at wk -2 confirms readiness.
**Special weeks**: Race week override (above). Recovery week (1 week active recovery) mandatory post-race.

entries.heading: C2 · Race prep — long distance (half marathon to ultra)
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Run template (subtypes selected per phase). Strength: Lower P / Full Body 1× per week for maintenance.
**Frequency coupling**: 5-6 sessions/week typical for half marathon+; ultra-prep adds back-to-back long sessions in build phase. Strength 1-2×/week.
**Conditioning subtypes**:
*Base phase (wk -16 to -10)*: Polarized base. Long run 1×/week, distance modest progression.
*Build phase (wk -10 to -4)*: Pyramidal. Long run distance progresses 10% rule per mesocycle.
*Peak phase (wk -4 to -1)*: Volume reduces, longest long run at wk -3 to -4.
*Race week*: Race week override.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 C2 Achievement markers. Long-run distance peak confirms readiness.
**Special weeks**: Race week override. Extended recovery (2-4 weeks active recovery) mandatory post-race for half marathon+; longer for ultra.

entries.heading: C3 · Trail running / mountain racing
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Run template (with elevation emphasis). Strength: Lower P / Full Body 1-2×/week.
**Frequency coupling**: 4-5 sessions/week. Mix of road and trail. Strength includes Nordic Hamstring Curl (#32) for descent eccentric loading.
**Conditioning subtypes**:
*Base phase*: Polarized. Trail sessions 1-2×/week for technical skill maintenance.
*Build phase*: Pyramidal with hill-specific intervals. Cumulative weekly elevation gain progressive.
*Peak phase*: Technical session at wk -2 (race-similar terrain). Volume drops, technique holds.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 C3 Achievement markers (race completion OR cumulative elevation reached for non-racing users).
**Special weeks**: Race week override. Recovery week post-race.

entries.heading: C4 · Hybrid athlete (Hyrox-style)
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (Hybrid-in-comeback persona phasing where applicable)
*Hybrid-in-comeback Phase 1 / 2 / 3*: For users returning from extended pause with cross-modal history.
*Non-comeback C4*: Full Body 2-3×/week + Run template 2-3×/week. Lower P + Upper PP for split-strength variation.
**Frequency coupling**: 5-6 sessions/week typical (Hyrox demands cross-modal volume). Phase-dependent for comeback users; trained-user C4 = full 6-day mixed week.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Hyrox-specific (Mangine 2020). Station simulations introduced in build phase. Practice-event at wk -3 (flag via race-simulation checkbox per Layer 4 C4 Detection field).
**Combo session**: Available in Phase 2 (Hybrid-in-comeback Phase 2 template, 1×/week).
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 C4 Achievement markers. Event time at target OR practice-event simulation at target.
**Special weeks**: Race week override (event week). Mid-camp readiness check at wk -4 (per C4 Achievement markers).

entries.heading: C5 · Cycling event prep
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Run template (substituted with cycling-specific protocol; Bike subtype defined by Layer 5 conditioning pattern). Strength: Lower P 1×/week + Full Body 1×/week for maintenance.
**Frequency coupling**: 4-6 sessions/week. Heavy on bike volume (3-5 rides/week including 1 long ride). Strength 1-2×/week.
**Conditioning subtypes**:
*Base phase*: Polarized. Long ride 1×/week, distance modest progression. FTP test at start.
*Build phase*: Pyramidal with threshold work. Long ride distance progressive. FTP test mid-block.
*Peak phase*: FTP test at wk -3 confirms readiness. Volume reduces wk -2 to -1.
*Race week*: Race week override.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 C5 Achievement markers. Event completion at target time/power. FTP test wk -3 as primary readiness indicator.
**Special weeks**: Race week override. Recovery week post-event.

entries.heading: C6 · Combat sports prep
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Lower P / Upper PP 2×/week + Full Body 1×/week + sport-specific conditioning (boxing/MMA/grappling skill sessions, NOT scheduled by Layer 5 — assumed external).
**Frequency coupling**: 3 strength + sport-specific volume per coach (Layer 5 does not schedule sport-specific). Strength volume reduces in fight week.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Sport-specific intervals + 1× Zone 2 row or run for capacity. Tempo work used sparingly to avoid interference with skill sessions.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 C6 Achievement markers. Competition day = single-test. Mid-camp readiness check at wk -4.
**Special weeks**: Race week override (fight week). Post-event extended recovery (mental + physical), debrief week.

entries.heading: C7 · Racquet sports
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Lower P 1×/week + Upper PP 1×/week + sport-play sessions (not scheduled by Layer 5). Upper + Core 1×/week for shoulder/torso emphasis in-season.
**Frequency coupling**: 2-3 strength + sport-play per user/coach. In-season strength volume reduces to maintain freshness for matches.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Sport-play IS the conditioning. Optional Zone 2 1×/week off-season; minimal in-season.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 C7 Achievement markers. Tournament results OR off-court performance markers.
**Special weeks**: Tournament week pattern (like Race week — maintenance, no new stimulus). Post-tournament recovery if multi-day event.

entries.heading: C8 · Climbing / bouldering
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Upper PP / Upper + Core 1-2×/week + climbing sessions (not scheduled by Layer 5 — climbing volume per user/coach). Lower P 1×/week minimum for posterior chain support.
**Frequency coupling**: 2-3 strength + 2-4 climbing sessions per user. Hangboard sessions count as strength-adjacent.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Climbing IS the conditioning. Optional Zone 2 1×/week for general aerobic base.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 C8 Achievement markers. Grade send + hangboard target reached.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Project-send focus week (reduced strength volume, climbing prioritized) — apply pattern when user reports project attempts.

entries.heading: C9 · Team sport season prep
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
*Pre-season*: Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A / Upper + Core 4-day split + sport conditioning.
*In-season*: Full Body 2×/week (maintenance-focused) + sport practice/games.
*Off-season*: Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A / Upper + Core 4-day split (full strength + capacity build).
**Frequency coupling**: Pre-season = 4-5 sessions/week. In-season = 2 strength + games/practice (volume reduces). Off-season = 4-5 sessions/week.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Sport-specific volume per coach (not scheduled by Layer 5). Sprint + agility tests per Achievement markers; cap intensity at RPE 7 during in-season.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 C9 Achievement markers. Pre-season readiness suite (sprint, agility, conditioning tests at target). In-season = rolling 4-week monitoring.
**Special weeks**: In-season weekly monitoring loop. Tournament/championship week = Race week pattern.
---

entries.heading: D1 · General health maintenance
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (single-block goal, indefinite)
Full Body 2-3 day (primary). Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A 3-day for users wanting more structure. Mobility template 1-2×/week as compatible secondary.
**Frequency coupling**: 2-3 days/week standard. ≥75% session completion target per Achievement markers.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Zone 2 2-3×/week (per general health guidelines + Productvisie's Moment 4 ritual support). Optional tempo 1×/week for users wanting cardiometabolic emphasis (route to D2).
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 D1 Achievement markers. Rolling 12-week assessment.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Quarterly check-in prompt per Achievement markers.

entries.heading: D2 · Cardiovascular health focus
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Run template (Zone 2 emphasis). Strength: Full Body 1-2×/week OR Lower P / Upper PP 2×/week.
**Frequency coupling**: 3-5 sessions/week. 2-3 Zone 2 sessions + 1-2 strength.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Polarized base (Seiler) as default. Zone 2 60-80% of conditioning volume. HRV and resting HR tracked.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 D2 Achievement markers. 12-week rolling window. Resting HR -5 bpm or HRV up.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Wearable data check at wk12 prompt.

entries.heading: D3 · Metabolic health
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Full Body 2-3 day OR Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A 3-day. Mobility template 1×/week as compatible secondary.
**Frequency coupling**: 3 days/week strength + 2-3 days/week conditioning (post-meal walks per Reynolds 2016 are explicitly named in Achievement markers but not formally scheduled by Layer 5 — these are user-managed).
**Conditioning subtypes**: Zone 2 + optional tempo. Walking post-meal flagged in Layer 4 Sources; user discretion on integration.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 D3 Achievement markers. Clinical markers per medical cycle (3-6 months).
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Bloodwork-check prompt per Achievement markers.

entries.heading: D4 · Bone density
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A 3-day or 4-day split (compound loading critical for bone density per LIFTMOR protocol). Full Body 2-3 day for time-constrained users.
**Frequency coupling**: 3-4 days/week strength essential. Heavy compounds prioritized (deadlift, overhead press, jumping chin-up per LIFTMOR target loads).
**Conditioning subtypes**: Optional Zone 2 1-2×/week. Walking/running provides impact loading (bone-positive); minimal swimming/cycling (low-impact, less bone-positive).
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 D4 Achievement markers. DEXA scan annual; proxy markers rolling 12-week.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Annual DEXA prompt.

entries.heading: D5 · Mobility & joint health
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Mobility template (primary). Lower P / Upper PP 1-2×/week as compatible secondary if user wants strength alongside. Full Body 2×/week alternative for users mixing emphasis.
**Frequency coupling**: 1-2× Mobility sessions/week standalone + 1-2× strength sessions/week if desired. Mobility 20-min add-on to strength days alternative.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Optional Zone 2 1×/week for general aerobic base. Not central to D5.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 D5 Achievement markers. ROM tests every 4 weeks.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. ROM test prompt every 4 weeks.
---

entries.heading: E1 · Knee rehab
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
*Phase 1 (Acute/Sub-acute, pain-managed)*: Mobility template + isolated rehab protocol (NOT scheduled by Layer 5 — assumed under physiotherapist guidance for first 2-4 weeks). Optional Upper PP 1-2×/week for non-knee load.
*Phase 2 (Loaded reintroduction)*: Reactivator Phase 2 Loaded with knee-aware overlay (swap Walking Lunge → Reverse Lunge or Step-Up; cap depth on Goblet Squat).
*Phase 3 (Return to capacity)*: Reactivator Phase 3 Capacity OR (if Returning Athlete persona) Returning Athlete Phase 2-3 with knee-friendlier slot biases.
**Frequency coupling**: Phase 1 = 1-2 sessions/week + rehab protocol. Phase 2 = 2-3 days/week. Phase 3 = 3-4 days/week.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Phase 1 = none or bike-easy only. Phase 2 = Zone 2 walking/bike. Phase 3 = Zone 2 1-2×/week; no impact running without clearance.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 E1 Achievement markers. Symmetry test (single-leg squat 70°, single-leg hop within 10%) + 4 weeks pain-free.
**Special weeks**: Symptom-flare week override (drop to prior phase). Coordination with physiotherapist on milestone confirmations.

entries.heading: E2 · Lower back rehab
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
*Phase 1*: Mobility template + McGill big-3 protocol (named in Layer 4, executed as core protocol — Layer 5 references this). No spinal loading. Upper PP 1×/week non-back-loaded.
*Phase 2 (Loaded reintroduction)*: Reactivator Phase 2 Loaded with hinge-pattern progression (Cable Pull-Through → loaded RDL); cap Ab Roll-Out volume.
*Phase 3 (Return to capacity)*: Reactivator Phase 3 OR (if Returning Athlete persona) Returning Athlete Phase 2-3 with hinge-aware slot biases.
**Frequency coupling**: Phase 1 = 2-3 sessions/week (Mobility-heavy + protocol). Phase 2 = 3 days/week. Phase 3 = 3-4 days/week.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Phase 1 = walking only. Phase 2 = Zone 2 bike/walk. Phase 3 = Zone 2 1-2×/week.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 E2 Achievement markers. 4 weeks pain-free in daily activities + McGill big-3 endurance test at functional levels + loaded hinge tolerated.
**Special weeks**: Symptom-flare week override.

entries.heading: E3 · Shoulder rehab
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
*Phase 1*: Mobility template + scapular protocol (rotator cuff + serratus emphasis). Lower P 1-2×/week non-shoulder-loaded. NO overhead loading.
*Phase 2*: Reactivator Phase 2 Loaded with shoulder-aware overlay (Cluster 2 #34 DB Bench Press neutral-grip, NO overhead press; #39 Face Pull + #41 Rear Delt Fly mandatory accessory; cap pull-up to assisted/inverted row variants).
*Phase 3*: Reactivator Phase 3 OR Returning Athlete Phase 2-3 with overhead reintroduction (light load progression per protocol).
**Frequency coupling**: Phase 1 = 2-3 sessions/week (Mobility + Lower P). Phase 2 = 3 days/week. Phase 3 = 3-4 days/week.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Phase 1 = Zone 2 walking/bike/row (no high-stroke-rate row pulls). Phase 2 = Zone 2 1-2×/week. Phase 3 = full conditioning subtype range per user goal.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 E3 Achievement markers. Full pain-free ROM + symmetric strength within 10% + overhead patterns reintroduced without symptom return.
**Special weeks**: Symptom-flare week override.

entries.heading: E4 · Hip rehab
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
*Phase 1*: Mobility template + hip-specific protocol (Glute Bridge #26, Dead Bug #53, supine 90/90). Upper PP 1-2×/week.
*Phase 2*: Reactivator Phase 2 Loaded with hip-friendly slot overlay (Step-Up #30 preferred over Walking Lunge; loaded Hip Thrust #21; Cable Pull-Through #25).
*Phase 3*: Reactivator Phase 3 OR Returning Athlete Phase 2-3.
**Frequency coupling**: Phase 1 = 2-3 sessions/week. Phase 2 = 3 days/week. Phase 3 = 3-4 days/week.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Phase 1 = walking. Phase 2 = Zone 2 walking/bike. Phase 3 = Zone 2 1-2×/week.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 E4 Achievement markers. 4 weeks pain-free + loaded hinge and single-leg squat tolerated.
**Special weeks**: Symptom-flare week override.

entries.heading: E5 · Achilles / calf rehab
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
*Phase 1*: Mobility template + calf eccentric protocol (heel raise progression, NOT scheduled by Layer 5 — assumed protocol). Upper PP 1-2×/week non-calf-loaded.
*Phase 2*: Reactivator Phase 2 Loaded with running-deferred overlay (NO running in Phase 2; bike substituted). Step-Up and Reverse Lunge in unilateral slots.
*Phase 3*: Reactivator Phase 3 with walk-run progression introduced per E5 protocol.
**Frequency coupling**: Phase 1 = 2-3 sessions/week. Phase 2 = 3 days/week. Phase 3 = 3-4 days/week including walk-run.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Phase 1 = bike only. Phase 2 = Zone 2 bike. Phase 3 = walk-run progression (per E5 Achievement markers).
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 E5 Achievement markers. 25+ rep single-leg heel raise symmetric + pain-free running progression.
**Special weeks**: Symptom-flare week override.

entries.heading: E6 · Wrist / elbow rehab
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
*Phase 1*: Mobility template + eccentric protocol (Tyler twist or similar, NOT scheduled by Layer 5). Lower P 1-2×/week non-grip-loaded.
*Phase 2*: Reactivator Phase 2 Loaded with grip-progressive overlay (neutral-grip variants preferred; cap pull-up to assisted if grip is limit).
*Phase 3*: Reactivator Phase 3 OR Returning Athlete Phase 2-3 with full grip patterns reintroduced.
**Frequency coupling**: Phase 1 = 2-3 sessions/week. Phase 2 = 3 days/week. Phase 3 = 3-4 days/week.
**Conditioning subtypes**: All phases = Zone 2 bike/row (per grip tolerance) or walking.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 E6 Achievement markers. 4 weeks pain-free + sport-specific demand tolerated.
**Special weeks**: Symptom-flare week override.

entries.heading: E7 · Return-to-training after extended pause
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (note: E7 closely overlaps with A1/A2 comeback persona phasing — primary scheduling defers to A1 or A2 if user has set those as primary goal)
*Phase 1*: Reactivator Phase 1 Foundation (2-day) OR Hybrid-in-comeback Phase 1 (3-day strength + 2-day Z2) per user history.
*Phase 2*: Reactivator Phase 2 Loaded OR Returning Athlete Phase 1 Re-entry (3-day).
*Phase 3*: Reactivator Phase 3 OR Returning Athlete Phase 2-3.
**Frequency coupling**: Phase 1 = 2 days/week. Phase 2 = 3 days/week. Phase 3 = 3-4 days/week.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Phase 1 = optional Zone 2 walk only. Phase 2 = Zone 2 1×/week. Phase 3 = up to Zone 2 + tempo per goal direction.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 E7 Achievement markers. 4 consecutive weeks of full programmed sessions without injury or excessive soreness + capacity at ~70-80% of pre-pause baseline.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Recovery week if symptoms re-emerge.
---

entries.heading: F1 · Pregnancy — early (T1)
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (gestational phase = Layer 4 phase = Layer 5 phase, 1:1 mapping)
Full Body 2-3 day (light load, no overhead heavy, no supine work beyond T1 midpoint). Mobility template 1-2×/week. NO Reactivator/Returning Athlete templates (those assume non-pregnant context).
**Frequency coupling**: 2-3 sessions/week. User's baseline activity governs starting point.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Zone 2 walking/easy bike/easy swim. NO intervals, NO tempo above conversational pace.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 F1 Achievement markers. Phase = T1 end (~wk 12-14). Transitions automatically to F2 at gestational marker.
**Special weeks**: Symptom-flare week (nausea, fatigue, bleeding) → drop to Mobility-only week. Medical-advice override always wins.

entries.heading: F2 · Pregnancy — mid (T2 + early T3)
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Full Body 2-3 day adapted (no supine heavy, no overhead heavy, no contact). Mobility template 1-2×/week. Lower P with hip-thrust emphasis acceptable up to gestational comfort.
**Frequency coupling**: 2-3 sessions/week. Adaptations per gestational week.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Zone 2 walking/easy bike/easy swim. Conversational pace.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 F2 Achievement markers. Phase = end of T2 / start of T3 (~wk 28).
**Special weeks**: Symptom-flare week override. Medical advice override.

entries.heading: F3 · Pregnancy — late (late T3)
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Mobility template (primary). Full Body 2-day light load OR walking-only per comfort. NO loaded compounds in final weeks.
**Frequency coupling**: 2 sessions/week typical, often dropping to 1 + daily walking by late T3.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Walking only.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 F3 Achievement markers. Phase = delivery.
**Special weeks**: Pre-delivery week is naturally a maintenance week.

entries.heading: F4 · Postpartum reconditioning
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (Phase 1 / 2 / 3 = Layer 4 F4 phase definitions; medical clearance gates apply)
*Phase 1*: Mobility template + postpartum-specific protocol (pelvic floor + deep core reconnection, NOT scheduled by Layer 5 — assumed under PT guidance). Walking only conditioning.
*Phase 2*: Reactivator Phase 2 Loaded with postpartum overlay (NO loaded compounds until Phase 2 entry medical clearance; pelvic floor symptom check before progressing; doming check during loaded patterns).
*Phase 3*: Reactivator Phase 3 OR (with hybrid history) Hybrid-in-comeback Phase 3. Full strength and conditioning per user goal.
**Frequency coupling**: Phase 1 = 2-3 days/week (Mobility-heavy). Phase 2 = 3 days/week. Phase 3 = 3-4 days/week.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Phase 1 = walking only. Phase 2 = Zone 2 walking/bike. Phase 3 = full conditioning subtype range per user goal.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 F4 Achievement markers. Each phase has 4-week stable window before progression. Phase gating includes pelvic floor symptom absence + diastasis check.
**Special weeks**: Symptom-flare week (pelvic floor, doming) → drop to prior phase. Medical-advice override always wins.

entries.heading: F5 · Menopause / perimenopause-aware training
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (single-block goal, indefinite per Layer 4 Achievement markers)
Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A / Upper + Core 4-day split (strength preservation priority) OR Full Body 3-day. Mobility template 1-2×/week as compatible secondary.
**Frequency coupling**: 3-4 days/week. Strength volume preserved; bone-density emphasis (D4 overlap).
**Conditioning subtypes**: Zone 2 2-3×/week. Optional tempo 1×/week if user wants cardiometabolic emphasis. Recovery markers monitored carefully per symptom-affected phases.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 F5 Achievement markers. Rolling quarterly review; no graduation.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Quarterly symptom-and-training check prompt.

entries.heading: F6 · Senior fitness (60+)
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (single-block goal, indefinite)
Full Body 2-3 day (primary). Mobility template 1-2×/week as compatible secondary. Reactivator Phase 1-2 templates acceptable as entry-level for very deconditioned seniors.
**Frequency coupling**: 2-3 days/week. Reactivator-style 2-day entry for deconditioned users; 3-day for active seniors.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Zone 2 walking 2-3×/week. Balance work included per Achievement markers (single-leg stand, sit-to-stand) — Layer 1 Mobility template covers these.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 F6 Achievement markers. Rolling quarterly review; no graduation.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Quarterly balance + functional self-test prompt.

entries.heading: F7 · Youth athletics (12–16)
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (single-block goal, phase-based per Layer 4 annual review)
Full Body 2-3 day age-appropriate (load scaled per training age). NO heavy compounds before adolescent growth plate maturity per coach/parent guidance. Mobility template 1×/week.
**Frequency coupling**: 2-3 strength sessions/week + sport practice (not scheduled by Layer 5).
**Conditioning subtypes**: Sport practice IS the conditioning. Optional Zone 2 1×/week for aerobic base.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 F7 Achievement markers. Annual review (school/season cycle). Movement competency at each phase end.
**Special weeks**: Season transitions = special week. Adapt to school exam periods per coach/parent input.
---

entries.heading: G1 · Glute development
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**: (single-block goal)
Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A / Upper + Core 4-day split with glute-emphasis slot biases. Lower P 2×/week if user wants accelerated focus. Full Body 3-day for time-constrained users.
**Frequency coupling**: 3-4 days/week. Hip Thrust #21 + Cable Pull-Through #25 + RDL #7 prioritized in slot selection.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Optional Zone 2 1-2×/week. Avoid extensive running during dedicated G1 block (interference with glute hypertrophy).
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 G1 Achievement markers. 12-16 week focused block; measurement + photo every 4 weeks.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Measurement + photo prompt at wk 4, 8, 12.

entries.heading: G2 · Arm focus / upper body aesthetic
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Upper PP / Upper + Core emphasized (2× per week). Lower P / Lower A maintenance (1× each per week). Full Body 3-day for time-constrained users with arm-emphasis slot biases.
**Frequency coupling**: 4 days/week typical for dedicated arm block. Upper hits per week prioritized over lower.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Optional Zone 2 1-2×/week. Same hypertrophy-interference caution as A2.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 G2 Achievement markers. 12-16 week focused block; arm measurement + photo every 4 weeks.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Measurement prompt.

entries.heading: G3 · Athletic look
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A / Upper + Core 4-day split (composite goal — strength + hypertrophy + aesthetic). Returning Athlete Phase 3 for comeback-history users.
**Frequency coupling**: 4 days/week standard. 5-day split for advanced users.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Zone 2 1-2×/week minimum (athletic look includes conditioning aesthetic). Optional tempo 1×/week.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 G3 Achievement markers. 16-24 week composite block; photo + measurements at milestones.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Milestone photo prompt.

entries.heading: G4 · Posture / desk-worker re-balancing
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Mobility template (primary, 1-2×/week). Upper + Core 1-2×/week with postural emphasis (Face Pull #39, Rear Delt Fly #41 prioritized; Lateral Raise #40 deprioritized). Lower P 1×/week.
**Frequency coupling**: 3-4 days/week. Mobility-heavy. Strength volume serves postural patterns.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Optional Zone 2 walking 2-3×/week (counters sitting).
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 G4 Achievement markers. 12-week initial markers; maintenance ongoing.
**Special weeks**: Standard deload. Postural self-check prompt wk 8 and 12.

entries.heading: G5 · Stage prep — amateur natural
entries.content_markdown:
**Eligible templates**:
Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A / Upper + Core 4-day split with hypertrophy bias in off-season; transitioning to higher volume + deficit-adjusted conditioning in prep.
**Frequency coupling**: 4-5 days/week strength + 2-3 days/week conditioning during prep. Off-season 4 days/week strength + 1-2 days/week conditioning.
**Conditioning subtypes**: Zone 2 2-3×/week during prep (calorie expenditure). Off-season optional Zone 2 1×/week.
**Phase transitions**: Per Layer 4 G5 Achievement markers. Stage day = single-test. Mid-prep check at wk -8.
**Special weeks**: Race week pattern (show week). Post-show MANDATORY structured reverse diet + recovery period (8-16 weeks, per Achievement markers Next step).
---
